title: ComplexSignedWebhookProcessor
description: A webhook processing API where integrations submit signed event payloads, the service verifies the delivery before recording it, and clients can inspect accepted events for their own integrations.
generation_notes: Verify HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body, timestamp, and event ID before parsing or persisting an event.
Timestamps older than 300 seconds must be rejected; compare signatures in constant time.
A duplicate integration ID and event ID must return 409 without recording another event.
Limit the request body to 262144 bytes before buffering or processing it.
Keep webhook delivery simulation local; do not require an external webhook provider.
